summary: Quiet residential kerb near the southern end, homes close all round.

best_section.where: Southern end of the stretch, just north of the T-junction

drivers.seclusion: Nearest mapped dwellings 18 m across the road and 29 m on own side; houses all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential street, cars park on the west side; kerb has room to stop.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street, but no camping convention.

flags: Dwelling 5 m from kerb from about 20 m north
Low-lying: about 7.4 m elevation, Cubberla Creek 183 m away
sun_shade: Mixed: tree canopy over the southern end, mostly from the south and west.
